title: Elite: Swear the World-Root Snare Path: Relic Detour
description: Elite: Swear the World-Root Snare Path: Relic Detour is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate (Ruin Gate with active oath memory). One selected deity from Odin, Freyja, Frigg, Thor enters; this beat spotlights Odin as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the treasure or lore step at World-Root Snare Path, using storm bridge and world-root trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances World-Root Snare Path and reveals: How oaths become physical law near the Gate. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
